rationale:
Issue #208 states the prefix of the last node is miscalculated when its value is a List and must be increased to start at the parent node column, and its body shows the exact defective rendering ('└── empty_list' followed by a 3-space '└── (empty)'). The minimized production patch touches only the TreeNodeType.iterable branch of AnsiTreeView._parseTreeNode, introducing extraTab and appending it to the last-node prefix ('$prefix$tab$extraTab'), which is precisely the one-column increase the issue requests, suppressed for center alignment where the existing tabSize already compensates. The minimization correctly drops the two unrelated parts of the upstream commit: the theme.dart default change (valueTheme alignment center→left and wrapOptions lineLength 120→100, a default-configuration/behavior change independent of the prefix bug) and the cosmetic reordering of '1 + _lineLength' to '_lineLength + 1' in the tabSize switch; the example/treeview/empty.dart edit is also excluded. What remains is a single behavioral hunk with no refactor, formatting, feature, doc, config, or test content. The trigger patch is test-only and consists solely of upstream expected-output corrections: one additional leading space before the last-node '└── (empty)' in the left/right/null value-alignment mocks of alignment_test.dart (center mocks intentionally unchanged, matching the fix's center exclusion) and a uniform one-column shift of the trailing 'list' subtree in treeviewMixedMockLeft/Right of mocks.dart, which is the same last-iterable-node prefix behavior. It uses only the pre-existing AnsiTreeView/AnsiTreeViewTheme API and introduces no API added by the fix. Strict machine evidence reports both gates passed: builds on both revisions, 10 declared selectors valid and unique, buggy differential reproduced on all 10 (8 alignment_test cases plus the two mixed-alignment tree_view_test cases), fixed isolated/suite/reversed runs clean, full suite green on fixed with buggy failures confined to the reproduced triggers, deterministic across 3 repetitions with 12 fingerprint groups. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and nikosportolos/ansix#208 is the supplied verified issue key, so no duplicate root cause.

Issue #208 (label 'bug', body in source_candidate.issue_check.linked_issues) states the prefix of the last node is miscalculated when its type is a List, and shows a rendering where the final 'empty_list' child is indented one column short of alignment with its parent. The minimized production patch touches exactly that path: in AnsiTreeView._parseTree the TreeNodeType.iterable branch now appends a one-space extraTab to the last-node prefix ('$prefix$tab$extraTab') for non-center alignment, which is the increase the issue asks for. The trigger patch changes only expected mock strings, adding exactly one space before the '└── (empty)' line of the last list node in alignment_test.dart and shifting the last-node 'list' subtree by one column in the treeviewMixedMockLeft/Right fixtures of mocks.dart; no new production API is used, and both files exist at the buggy revision, so the trigger is the pre-existing upstream assertion corrected to the reported behavior. The curator correctly excluded the unrelated parts of the original commit: the theme.dart default changes (valueTheme alignment center→left, wrapOptions lineLength 120→100), the cosmetic reordering of the tabSize switch arms (1 + _lineLength → _lineLength + 1), the example/treeview/empty.dart demo edit, the test restructuring plus added keyTheme/wrapOptions arguments, and the mock blocks (treeviewNestedMock, noHeaderMap, noHeaderMapSingleEntry, padded-header mock) whose deltas were driven by those theme defaults rather than by the prefix defect. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization matrices passes all gates: 10 unique selectors, buggy differential reproducing all 10 (8 alignment_test cases plus the two mixed-alignment tree_view_test cases), fixed isolated/suite/reversed runs clean, fixed full suite green, buggy full-suite failures confined to the reproduced triggers, deterministic across 3 repetitions. Root cause is nikosportolos/ansix#208, which is the only allowed id and active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so there is no duplicate.

risks: The defect and all triggers are whitespace-exact golden-string comparisons of rendered ANSI/box-drawing output, so any future formatter or terminal-width change could shift assertions for reasons unrelated to this root cause.

The benchmark fixed state (minimized patch only) intentionally differs from the upstream fixed revision, which also changed the default valueTheme alignment and wrap line length; results are not comparable to upstream default rendering.

The fix deliberately exempts center alignment, so the accepted behavior is alignment-conditional rather than a uniform prefix rule; a later upstream change to center handling would not be covered by these triggers.
Issue #208 carries both 'bug' and 'enhancement' labels; acceptance rests on the issue body describing a miscalculation of existing output, not on the label set.
